claim: Story nights 3, 4 and 5 cleared on the Moto g56, unlocking 6th Night after an app-data wipe had reset the save to Night 1. Night 6 remains open. All runs --machine-only (explicit MODEL_ONLY machine-input experiment, claim promotion suppressed).

runs.label: toys-n3-ladder
runs.outcome: died 339.7 s, Balloon Boy; 0 visible hall flashes in 43 intervals, 34 latched-mask intervals

findings: Balloon Boy is cleared only by VENT_MASK_TICKS = 5 ticks on one-second boundaries while maskFullyOn (g292/g293/g294/g907, e237), and maskFullyOn excludes the 200 ms put-on. The shipped Minus Toys cycle holds the mask 14449->19200 = 4751 ms, 4551 fully on, spanning 4 OR 5 boundaries against a required 5. Zero margin, phase-dependent. The model does not see it: 3000/3000 on Night 3 with sim.bb.inside false in 300/300.

Nights 3 and 4 tolerate widening the window (maskOffMs 9700, hallOffsetMs 10016: 5051 ms fully on, 3000/3000). NIGHT 6 DOES NOT: mask-off later with hall at 10016 scores 0/3000 all Foxy, and widening from the mask-on side scores 28/1000 inside-office. The shipped 4551 ms is optimal there, and it wins in the model because the PHASE is aligned -- which is what anchorEpochMs controls.

The unanchored Night 6 winner released at a drawn phase and died at 69.6 s to Balloon Boy. The anchored binding fnv1a-3d5b2167 (anchorEpochMs 4850) has no ANCHOR_AIMS entry, so night-run.sh refuses it. Night 6 needs an anchor aim, not a knob.

Arm verification tracked the outcome on every run: VERIFIED -> 6 AM, UNRESOLVED -> death. observe-once samples once and proceeds blind; the Night 5 run that died at 48.4 s was unresolved, and 48 s matches that night's 20 s box-empty time rather than any animatronic.

The device compiler did not gate wind on the viewed camera. plant-model.js credits winding only while viewing === BOX_CAM (11); artifact-commands.mjs required monitor-up alone, so a plan could schedule a wind with another camera viewed, compile clean, and be a silent no-op. Now refused against the plan's declared #arm-verify-viewing.
